title: Recipe 31 — Session Resume and Replay (the shell is the interface)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Two files per run: metadata for fast listing, an append-only JSONL for the truth. Resume walks the conversation and nothing else.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed starter is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — only the resume beats need it.

groups.title: Beat 1 · the spec the recipe resumes

beats.label: Type the recipe's own spec
beats.cue: “The recipe's resume line names starters/cli — so that's what we type. Seven lines; sessions are free, not configured.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Clean. Note there is no sessions block to lint — persistence is a runtime property, not spec surface.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “Nothing about sessions in the IR either. What the bundle carries is a session name and target — the store derives the rest.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target cli

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, boots it: GREEN. It also installs the session store and the event log we're about to drive directly.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate. Also lands live/dist/node_modules/@crewhaus/{session-store,event-log}, which the anatomy beats import.

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “Two lines carry the whole story — sessionName and sessionTarget. Everything else about a session is the store's business.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · session anatomy, written by the real store

beats.label: Create the recipe's session id
beats.cue: “The store writes it, not us — and it comes out mode 0600, readable only by the owner, with the id the recipe prints.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const {createSessionStore}=await import("./live/dist/node_modules/@crewhaus/session-store/dist/index.js"); const s=await createSessionStore().create({id:"sess_abc123def4567890",name:"hello",target:"cli",model:"claude-sonnet-5"}); const p=".crewhaus/sessions/"+s.id+".json"; const m=require("fs").statSync(p).mode & 0o777; console.log("wrote "+p+" mode 0"+m.toString(8)); if(!/^sess_[0-9a-f]{16}$/.test(s.id)) throw new Error("id is not sess_<16hex>"); if(m!==0o600) throw new Error("want 0600, got 0"+m.toString(8))'

verify.note: wrote .crewhaus/sessions/sess_abc123def4567890.json mode 0600; asserts the sess_<16hex> id shape and the 0o600 file mode the recipe claims

beats.label: Type the recipe's printed metadata
beats.cue: “This is the metadata block straight out of the recipe. Now let's see whether the store agrees with it.”

beats.label: Compare the recipe against the store
beats.cue: “Seven keys on each side, and they match exactly — id, createdAt, updatedAt, name, target, model, lastTurnIndex.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const k=p=>Object.keys(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(p,"utf8"))).sort(); const a=k("live/session-metadata.json"); const b=k(".crewhaus/sessions/sess_abc123def4567890.json"); console.log("recipe: "+a.join(", ")); console.log("store:  "+b.join(", ")); if(a.join()!==b.join()) throw new Error("the recipe and the store disagree")'

verify.note: both sides print the same seven sorted keys

beats.label: Write six events, then count the replayable ones
beats.cue: “Six events go in: a user turn, an assistant turn, a tool call, its result, a compaction, an error. Resume walks two of them — the conversation, never the side effects.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const {openEventLog}=await import("./live/dist/node_modules/@crewhaus/event-log/dist/index.js"); const log=await openEventLog("sess_abc123def4567890"); await log.append({kind:"user_message",payload:{content:"How do I resume a session?"}}); await log.append({kind:"assistant_message",payload:{content:[{type:"text",text:"Hand the id back to run with --resume."}]}}); await log.append({kind:"tool_use",payload:{name:"Read",input:{file_path:"README.md"}}}); await log.append({kind:"tool_result",payload:{content:"# demos"}}); await log.append({kind:"compaction",payload:{tokensBefore:9000,tokensAfter:4000}}); await log.append({kind:"error",payload:{name:"Error",message:"transient"}}); await log.close(); const {parseSessionLog}=await import("./live/dist/node_modules/@crewhaus/session-store/dist/index.js"); const evs=parseSessionLog(require("fs").readFileSync(".crewhaus/sessions/sess_abc123def4567890.jsonl","utf8")); const replayable=evs.filter(e=>e.kind==="user_message"||e.kind==="assistant_message"); console.log("log: "+evs.length+" events ("+evs.map(e=>e.kind).join(", ")+")"); console.log("resume reconstructs from "+replayable.length+" of them"); if(evs.length!==6||replayable.length!==2) throw new Error("unexpected log shape")'

verify.note: 6 events appended by the real event log; parseSessionLog finds exactly 2 replayable kinds — this is why resume never re-runs a tool side effect

groups.title: Beat 4 · the shell is the interface

beats.label: List sessions, newest first
beats.cue: “No sessions dashboard needed for this — they are files, so ls is the list command.”

verify.note: one line — the session the store beat just wrote

beats.label: Walk every user message
beats.cue: “And the recipe's own one-liner: pull the user's side of the conversation straight out of the JSONL.”

verify.note: prints `How do I resume a session?` — the one user turn in the log

groups.title: Beat 5 · hand the id back to run

beats.label: Resume the session by id
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The runtime loads the metadata, confirms the spec name matches, rebuilds the history, and opens a new turn.”

verify.note: interactive REPL; needs Anthropic credentials. Resumes the session the store beats wrote earlier in this drive — its two replayable events become the model's history. `--continue` takes the most-recent session instead of an explicit id.

beats.label: Ask it what you asked before
beats.cue: [needs-key] “It has the earlier turn in context — the answer refers back to it rather than starting cold.”
beats.text: What did I ask you a moment ago, and what was your answer?

beats.label: Exit the REPL
beats.cue: [needs-key] “exit” returns to the shell.

groups.title: One more thing · eviction, and the replay engine

beats.label: Age the session past its TTL
beats.cue: “Eviction is mtime-keyed, so the recipe's trick is exactly this: backdate the file.”

verify.note: the recipe's own touch line; sets the metadata's mtime to 2020

beats.label: Run the eviction pass
beats.cue: “Thirty days by default, and it takes the sibling event log with it. This is the runtime's only automatic deletion.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const {evictExpiredSessions,DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS}=await import("./live/dist/node_modules/@crewhaus/session-store/dist/index.js"); const {evictedIds}=await evictExpiredSessions(); console.log("ttlDays default: "+DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS+"; evicted: "+evictedIds.join(", ")); const fs=require("fs"); for(const p of [".crewhaus/sessions/sess_abc123def4567890.json",".crewhaus/sessions/sess_abc123def4567890.jsonl"]) if(fs.existsSync(p)) throw new Error(p+" survived eviction"); console.log("metadata and event log both gone")'

verify.note: ttlDays default: 30; evicted: sess_abc123def4567890; asserts both the .json and its sibling .jsonl are unlinked

beats.label: Run the Studio replay smoke
beats.cue: “Probe 4 is the replay engine the Studio viewer embeds: same events in, same events out, deterministically.”

verify.note: all probes pass; probe 4 is `trace-viewer: replay + drilldown deterministic`
